step1_analysis.description: A clocked comparator or level shifter used in the digital auto-calibration loop of the transmitter. It features an auto-zeroing input stage operating between 0.9V and 1.8V, and a second stage that shifts the output to a wider voltage swing.

paper_reference.title: A Quad-Band GSM-GPRS Transmitter With Digital Auto-Calibration

tuning_range.description: Frequency tuning range of the PLL

sky130_expected.calculation: System-level metric, not applicable to this sub-block.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends entirely on the VCO and PLL architecture.
Cannot be measured on a single comparator block.

trip_point.description: DC crossing voltage of the comparator

sky130_expected.reasoning: The first stage operates between 0.9V and 1.8V, so the logical threshold is around 1.35V.

prop_delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.calculation: Based on W=5u, L=0.5u and 10fF load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large transistors provide high drive strength, resulting in fast switching despite the 0.5um length.
The output pulls up to 1.8V and pulls down to the source of XM9, which is biased at ~0.4V by the diode-connected XM6.
Dynamic power for 100MHz switching with 10fF load is ~1.6uW, plus short-circuit and bias currents.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC trip point, propagation delay, output swing, and power consumption of the comparator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Auto-Calibration Comparator
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

XM1 N8 N5 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 N10 N8 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N4 N1 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 N1 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 LABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N3 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N9 N4 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N9 N4 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N4 N10 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N7 N5 LABEL_NET_0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VN2 N2 0 1.8
VN3 N3 0 0
VN1 N1 0 1.8
VN10 N10 0 0.9

VIN N5 0 dc 1.35 pulse(0.9 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4n 10n)
Cload N9 0 10f

.control
dc VIN 0.9 1.8 0.01
let diff1 = v(N4) - v(N5)
meas dc trip_point_n4 when diff1=0
let diff2 = v(N9) - v(N4)
meas dc trip_point_n9 when diff2=0

tran 10p 20n
meas tran delay_rise trig v(N5) val=1.35 rise=1 targ v(N9) val=1.35 rise=1
meas tran delay_fall trig v(N5) val=1.35 fall=1 targ v(N9) val=1.35 fall=1
meas tran v_max_n9 max v(N9)
meas tran v_min_n9 min v(N9)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power

print trip_point_n4 trip_point_n9 delay_rise delay_fall v_max_n9 v_min_n9 avg_power
quit
.endc
